cases.description: C1: a request for a whole company reads settings and the templates, proposes one plan or asks one question, and creates nothing before consent (no manage_gated, no claim).

turns.send: Dựng giúp mình một công ty bán hàng online, shop tên Gốm Lá, web gomla.example

cases.description: C2: after the person agrees to the plan, teams go to manage_gated (Cần bạn) and the reply says they wait for approval rather than claiming the company exists.

turns.send: Dựng công ty bán hàng online cho shop Gốm Lá (gomla.example) theo mẫu bán hàng: Marketing và CSKH, gói tiết kiệm. Mình đồng ý kế hoạch này, cứ làm.
